meta.base: multi-source compendium (Census, SRS, NFHS, PLFS, NCRB, et al.)
meta.source: MoSPI, from multiple source agencies (Office of the Registrar General, NFHS, NCRB, Ministry of Education, et al.)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each indicator is final as its underlying source publishes; the compendium is a curated cross-source portrait, never a single survey.
meta.coverage: All India; infant deaths per 1,000 live births, by gender, SRS 2008-2020
meta.note: Multi-source: each indicator carries its own underlying source (Census for sex ratio & literacy, SRS for fertility/mortality, PLFS for labour, NCRB for crime). Indicators are never spliced or chained — different cadences and frames make that dishonest. Values marked '-' at source are null; years marked '*' are projections.
